text.tspan: A practical identity system for an AI-ready web framework with a PHP foundation and integrated developer tools.
Lead Developer / Product Manager - Marcin Kordyaczny
FNLLA brings a structured foundation and
integrated project tools to developers building web
applications. The identity should make that
foundation visible: precise marks, legible information
and an orderly, useful product experience. Blueprint
means a considered plan or technical foundation:
start with structure, then build your application. It
does not promise automatic code generation.
The integrated full starter is the main FNLLA
experience. Plain is an advanced core-only option
from the same framework. Neither option needs a
separate logo, colour scheme or invented product
Use the visual examples, then the supplied masters.
Outline is the only approved signature, in blue, black,
grey or white on matching blue, black and grey
fields. Edition 2.2.0 expands the kit, not the
